ok_law_sunset.label: Legal protection expires
ok_law_sunset.quote: until July 1, 2026, the following are hereby authorized to engage in harm-reduction services

ok_hb2012.label: HB 2012 passes the House; never heard on the Senate floor
ok_hb2012.quote: The version that passed in the House established a one-year extension, but the bill was never heard on the Senate floor

ok_police_origin.label: The law was first filed to protect police from needle-stick injuries
ok_police_origin.quote: Protecting law enforcement officers motivated Carol Bush, along with Sen. John Montgomery, to file the bill in 2021

ok_penalty.label: Maximum penalty for distributing syringes after July 1
ok_penalty.quote: a maximum sentence of up to a year in jail ... fines up to $10,000

ok_syringes_osdh.label: Sterile syringes distributed (OSDH estimate)
ok_syringes_osdh.quote: The Oklahoma State Department of Health estimated the organizations distributed 1.25 million syringes between 2022 and 2025
ok_syringes_osdh.note: Article adds: more than 8800 people reached

ok_clients.label: Clients served by the four registered programs
ok_clients.quote: Between 2022 and 2024, Oklahoma's four harm reduction organizations served 8,896 clients and distributed 578,330 syringes.

ok_referrals.label: Clients referred to other services
ok_referrals.quote: The organizations also referred 1,528 clients for services, such as substance use education or testing for HIV and STIs.

ok_naloxone.label: Naloxone kits distributed (two doses each)
ok_naloxone.quote: the organizations distributed 25,125 naloxone kits, which included two doses each

ok_reversals.label: Overdose reversals reported with that naloxone
ok_reversals.quote: self-reported 1,212 overdose reversals from naloxone they distributed

ok_counties.label: Counties reached by the Oklahoma Harm Reduction Alliance
ok_counties.quote: Since 2021, the alliance has distributed sterile syringes to all 77 counties in the state

ev_hiv_hq.label: HIV transmission among people using syringe programs (six higher-quality studies)
ev_hiv_hq.quote: 0·42 (95% CI 0·22, 0·81) across six higher quality studies

ev_hiv_all.label: HIV transmission (all 12 studies)
ev_hiv_all.quote: pooled effect size 0·66 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0·43, 1·01] across all studies

ev_hcv_combo.label: Hepatitis C infection with high syringe coverage plus medication treatment
ev_hcv_combo.quote: combined high coverage of NSP and OST ... resulting in a 74% reduction in the risk of HCV acquisition (RR 0.26 95% CI 0.07 to 0.89)

ev_hcv_ost.label: Hepatitis C infection while on medication treatment (methadone or buprenorphine)
ev_hcv_ost.quote: current OST reduces the risk of HCV acquisition by 50% (risk ratio (RR) 0.50, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.40 to 0.63

ev_hcv_nsp_eu.label: Hepatitis C infection with high syringe coverage, European studies
ev_hcv_nsp_eu.quote: high NSP coverage in Europe was associated with a 76% reduction in HCV acquisition risk (RR 0.24, 95% CI 0.09 to 0.62)

ev_hcv_nsp_all.label: Hepatitis C infection with high syringe coverage alone, North America and Europe
ev_hcv_nsp_all.quote: very low-quality evidence that high NSP coverage did not reduce risk of HCV acquisition (RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.39 to 1.61)
ev_hcv_nsp_all.note: Cochrane 2017; shown so the weak result is visible

ev_treat_hagan.label: New exchange users entering drug treatment vs never-users (Seattle)
ev_treat_hagan.quote: New users of the exchange were five times more likely to enter drug treatment than never-exchangers.

ev_stop_hagan.label: Former exchange users who stopped injecting vs never-users (Seattle)

ev_treat_strathdee.label: Exchange clients entering treatment within 7 days with case management vs referral alone (Baltimore RCT)
ev_treat_strathdee.quote: Overall, 34% entered treatment within 7 days (intervention: 40% versus control: 26%, p=0.03)

ev_crime_marx.label: Arrest trends near vs away from Baltimore's exchange
ev_crime_marx.quote: No significant differences in arrest trends emerged.

ob_scott_cases.label: HIV infections in the Scott County, Indiana outbreak
ob_scott_cases.quote: with 215 HIV infections eventually attributed to the outbreak

ob_scott_hcv.label: Scott County case patients coinfected with hepatitis C
ob_scott_hcv.quote: 92.3% were coinfected with hepatitis C virus

ob_scott_ssp.label: Indiana's first syringe program opened only after the emergency declaration
ob_scott_ssp.quote: a public health emergency was declared on March 26, 2015, and a syringe-service program in Indiana was established for the first time

ob_scott_early.label: Infections an earlier response (Jan 2013) could have averted
ob_scott_early.quote: Initiation of a response on Jan 1, 2013, could have suppressed the number of infections to 56 or fewer, averting at least 127 infections

ob_kanawha_close.label: Kanawha-Charleston Health Department suspends its syringe program
ob_kanawha_close.quote: After suspension of the KCHD syringe services program (SSP) in March 2018 and a community-based SSP in April 2021

ob_kanawha_before.label: HIV diagnoses among people who inject drugs per year before the outbreak
ob_kanawha_before.quote: increased from less than five annually during 2016–2018 to 11 during January–October 2019

ob_kanawha_cases.label: People meeting the Kanawha outbreak case definition
ob_kanawha_cases.quote: As of October 27, 2021, 85 persons met the HIV outbreak case definition

ob_kanawha_sharing.label: Why people shared syringes after the closures
ob_kanawha_sharing.quote: PWID reported reusing or sharing syringes, mainly because of limited access to sterile syringes after SSP closures.

ok_circle_back.label: The sunset was meant to trigger a review of whether the programs helped
ok_circle_back.quote: agreed to circle back after five years and figure out if the sterile syringe programs had helped
ok_circle_back.note: Paraphrase of former Rep. Carol Bush by Oklahoma Watch

ok_bush_quote.label: Former Rep. Carol Bush on whether that review happened
ok_bush_quote.quote: I'm not sure that conversation ever happened,
